description: This Java class 'DisplayUtil' provides utility functions for querying display attributes such as display size, refresh rate, DPI, and managing display listeners within an Android environment.

classes.name: DisplayUtil
classes.description: A utility class for querying display attributes and managing display listeners on Android devices.

methods.name: getDisplayDpi
methods.description: Returns the physical pixels per inch of the screen in the X and Y dimensions.

methods.name: getDefaultDisplay
methods.description: Returns the default display associated with a context.

methods.name: getDefaultDisplayRefreshRate
methods.description: Returns the refresh rate of the default display.

methods.name: cacheDefaultDisplay
methods.description: Caches the default display and display metrics, typically triggered when a NativeActivity starts.

methods.name: getDisplayFromContext
methods.description: Returns the default display associated with a context, handling different API levels.

methods.name: getDisplaySize
methods.description: Returns the size of the physical display in pixels based on DisplayMetrics.

methods.name: getSystemDisplaySize
methods.description: Returns the current physical display size in pixels, possibly overridden by system properties.

methods.name: addDisplayListener
methods.description: Registers a display listener to monitor display changes.
